CROSS TARGET (Book #1) is the first book in an electrifying new action thriller series from the #1 bestselling and USA Today bestselling author Jack Mars (with over 10,000 five-star reviews).

Former Special Forces soldier Connor Cross rescues key individuals from the most dangerous places in the world when the U.S. government needs it handled discreetly and unofficially. But when the missions become something much bigger, affecting the very world’s stability, Connor must wonder: is he a pawn in a much bigger game of chess?

In CROSS TARGET (Book #1), Connor is tasked with escorting a UN weapons inspector safely out of a contested zone after her convoy is ambushed. But as he battles to get her out of the country, he discovers that the ambush may have been a clever ploy for something much bigger, threatening to set the stage for a multi-nation armed conflict.

Connor Cross doesn't do simple missions — and neither does this series, where every operation unravels into something bigger, deadlier, and harder to walk away from. Explosive action, relentless pacing, and twists you won't see coming make this a series that demands to be read in one sitting. Perfect for fans of Vince Flynn, David Baldacci, and Michael Connelly.

Future books in the series are also available!

“Thriller enthusiasts who relish the precise execution of an international thriller, but who seek the psychological depth and believability of a protagonist who simultaneously fields professional and personal life challenges, will find this a gripping story that's hard to put down.”

--Midwest Book Review, Diane Donovan (regarding Any Means Necessary)
